svg.title: Mercury-2.5: pass fractions across scored environments
svg.desc: Thirty-six environments with scored cases, each labeled by its PASS/scored count. Dots show recorded fractions; bars show 95 percent Wilson intervals under a binomial convention, not measured seed-to-seed variation. A dotted line marks the pooled 277/405 rate.
